# Kagin — full knowledge

Last updated: 2026-08-28
Canonical site: https://kagin.dev
Repository: https://github.com/Go7hic/Kagin
License: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (commercial use needs a separate license)

## Summary

Kagin is a source-available app license-key platform. One codebase supports hosted SaaS (email workspace signup + optional Stripe) and self-hosting on Cloudflare (external Admin JWT, no Stripe). It issues license keys, binds devices or floating seats, renews sessions via heartbeat, signs feature tokens with per-product Ed25519 keys, and exposes an admin console plus a TypeScript SDK.

## Product facts

- Hosted domain: https://kagin.dev
- Hosted price: $5 USD / month per workspace
- Hosted product limit: 5 products when Stripe billing is configured
- Unpaid hosted workspaces cannot create products (`402 payment_required`)
- Contact: hello@kagin.dev
- Stack: Hono API Worker, TanStack admin UI, TypeScript SDK
- Bindings: D1, KV, LicenseDO (Durable Object), Workers Assets, Send Email (`EMAIL`)

## Core capabilities

1. Products with optional feature schema and Ed25519 keypair
2. License types: `perpetual`, `subscription`, `floating`
3. Device binding via `machine_limit` and `POST /v1/activate` / `POST /v1/deactivate`
4. Floating / concurrent seats via `seat_limit` and LicenseDO heartbeats
5. Optional buyer `customer_identity` (email/phone) on activate/deactivate
6. Idempotent issuance with `external_reference` (payment webhook safe)
7. Feature tokens and ephemeral tokens for clients
8. Policies (offline tolerance, geo/IP) merged at heartbeat
9. Admin console: products, licenses, devices, sessions, kick, API keys, billing

## Public API (high level)

- `GET /health`
- `GET /v1/meta` — billing flags, price, product limit, contact email
- `GET /v1/server-time`
- `GET /v1/policy`
- `POST /v1/activate` — bind device
- `GET /v1/activations` — list bindings
- `POST /v1/deactivate` — unbind device (rebind on another machine)
- `POST /v1/heartbeat` — renew session / take seat
- `POST /v1/feature-token`
- `POST /v1/ephemeral-token`
- `POST /v1/stripe/webhook`

Admin routes live under `/admin/v1/*` (session cookie/Bearer, API key, or self-host JWT).

## Typical integration

1. Sign up at the console and create a product
2. Optionally generate an Ed25519 keypair for offline verification
3. Issue a license key (or fulfill from Stripe/webhook with `external_reference`)
4. App calls activate with `license_key` + stable `machine_id` (+ identity if bound)
5. App heartbeats and requests feature tokens as needed
6. To change devices: deactivate then activate, or admin unbind/bind in console

## Pricing and licensing

| Mode | Cost | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hosted SaaS | $5 / month | Up to 5 products; unlimited keys/devices/seats within product limit |
| Self-host (noncommercial) | Free under PolyForm Noncommercial | Same console/API/SDK on your Cloudflare account |
| Self-host (commercial) | Contact hello@kagin.dev | Separate commercial license required |

## Limitations (current)

- Single workspace per signup; no team invites, multi-org switcher, Magic link, or SSO
- Send Email binding exists; transactional product email flows are not built yet
- Docs UI is localized (en / zh / ja); repo `docs/` tree is mostly Chinese

## Compared with building in-house

Kagin provides enforceable machine limits and seat counters in the API (reject over-limit), signed offline-verifiable feature tokens, and a ready console. Alternatives are custom backends or closed SaaS licensing vendors; Kagin’s differentiator is source-available Cloudflare-native deployment you can audit and self-host.
